content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products can be frustrating when conventional payment platforms aren't available. For creators in countries like Nigeria or Ghana, relying on platforms such as Gumroad can mean losing up to 10% of every sale. With NOWPayments, you only pay a 0.5% fee, allowing you to retain more of your earnings. For example, if you sell a $97 ebook and make 100 sales per month, you keep an additional $921 by switching to a more efficient payment system. This shift is crucial for creators seeking to maximize their revenue and maintain sovereignty over their sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind Solana payments for digital products involves a combination of free and paid tools that operate seamlessly together. By utilizing Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery and NOWPayments for real-time crypto payment processing, you create a robust sales environment. The architecture ensures that you own everything post-deployment, meaning no third-party access to your data and no reliance on external platforms. This not only enhances security but also solidifies your independence as a digital creator, giving you complete control over your business operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who are tired of being locked out by conventional payment systems. Whether you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or digital software, the architecture suits various digital products, enabling you to reach global customers without the hurdles imposed by traditional payment platforms. The focus is on those who prioritize ownership and autonomy in their digital commerce ventures, providing an avenue to thrive in the increasingly digital landscape.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively utilize Solana payments, you need a few essential components: a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic platform such as Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for handling transactions. These components integrate to form a cohesive system where your digital products are stored and delivered automatically upon payment confirmation. Implementing these tools gives you an efficient and scalable solution for selling digital products while keeping the associated costs low, thereby enhancing your profitability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your digital store using Solana payments starts with selecting your infrastructure components. First, choose a hosting service and set up your product storage using Google Sheets or Supabase. Next, configure your backend logic via Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Once everything is configured correctly, you can start selling your products with a streamlined payment process. If you want a comprehensive guide to streamline this process, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your entire digital store without third-party dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in building a sovereign digital store without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all essential blueprints and templates you need to get started with Solana payments for your digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook using NOWPayments for crypto transactions, enabling you to bypass PayPal and Stripe altogether. This method allows for direct payments in cryptocurrency, ensuring you keep more of your profits.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Using Solana payments through NOWPayments is one of the best ways to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. You only pay a 0.5% transaction fee, which is significantly lower than the typical 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Absolutely. By utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack integrated with NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various forms of digital currency. This flexibility enables you to cater to a broader audience and adapt to customer preferences.
How do I ensure my digital store is secure?

To ensure security, choose a reliable hosting service and set up your backend logic correctly. Additionally, using NOWPayments guarantees that transactions are processed securely, giving you peace of mind.
